note: Original implementation summaries. This is an engine design aid, not Arena source code.

mechanics.name: Perpetual
mechanics.summary: Applies a persistent modification to a specific card object. The modification follows that card through normal zone changes for the rest of the game.
engine_requirements: copy rules that distinguish copiable values from perpetual changes

mechanics.name: Conjure
mechanics.summary: Creates a real card object that did not begin in a deck and places it in the instructed zone. It behaves as a card, not as a token, until the game ends.

mechanics.name: Seek
mechanics.summary: Randomly selects a card in the library that matches stated criteria and moves it to the instructed zone without revealing the library or shuffling it.
engine_requirements: audit log that hides private information

mechanics.name: Draft from a Spellbook
mechanics.summary: Presents a random subset from a fixed card list, lets the player choose one, then usually conjures the chosen card to the stated zone.

mechanics.name: Intensity
mechanics.summary: Stores a numeric value on a card and changes that value perpetually when its instructions say so. Rules text or effects may read the current value.

mechanics.name: Specialize
mechanics.summary: Pays a cost and discards a card of a chosen color or basic land type to transform the permanent into the corresponding specialized version.

mechanics.name: Double Team
mechanics.summary: When a nontoken creature with double team attacks, it conjures a duplicate of the original into its controller's hand; both the attacker and the new card then lose double team.

mechanics.name: Boon
mechanics.summary: Creates a player-held delayed effect. When its condition occurs, it triggers once and then disappears unless the effect says otherwise.

mechanics.name: Heist
mechanics.summary: Builds a private offer from cards associated with an opponent, lets the heisting player choose one, and makes the selected card available under the effect's casting rules.

mechanics.name: Rebalanced Card Version
mechanics.summary: Uses an Arena-specific rules definition for a card while preserving its identity links to the printed card for collection and format purposes.
